notes.title: Patch notes - Fix and improvements
notes.content:
Fixed several UI issues in the pause menu—it’s now clean and consistent.
Adjusted ship throttle speed per feedback.
Moved the ship wheel to avoid blocking the map.
Streamlined the info table.
Implemented performance optimizations.

notes.title: Enemy Hotfix
notes.content: Enemy bug patched for now. Full rework coming in the next weeks—this was just the duct tape fix

notes.title: Patch Notes – Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Update Notes[/b]

Brightness tweaked: From "where the hell am I?" to "oh great, now I see what’s hunting me."

Fixed: Inventory no longer freezes after level ends—your loot finally makes it home or vanish if you were left behind.

Minor optimizations and spooky vibes maintained. Nothing crawled out. Yet.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 18 – Major Performance Boost
notes.content:
This update brings a major FPS boost — we’ve tripled performance in some areas (from 20 to 60 FPS).

Expect smoother gameplay and better overall stability.

[b]Thanks for all your feedback — it really helps us improve![/b]

notes.title: Hotfix - Lobby
notes.content:
Hi , 

There has been complaint about lobby cannot be created, i tested it again and uploaded a new version.

If the game still doesn't let you create or join a lobby, please join our discord and share your log file for it. 

Log file seems to be located: C:\Users\<you>\AppData\LocalLow\<DaBomb Games>\<Rotten Sails>\Player.log

notes.title: Hotfix – Collider Fixes & Control Tweaks
notes.content:
Thanks in advance for any feedback — I’ve started addressing reported issues.

Fixes in this update:

Fixed ship being able to enter the first island (collider issue)

Ship door now opens with a click instead of hold

Throttle resets after ship collisions

Minor UI fixes

I'll be reworking the maps next to avoid similar issues. Feedback is welcome — we’re shaping this together.
